summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 17, 2026, attaching a press release titled 'Clearmind Medicine Commends Federal Momentum in Advancing Psychedelic-Based Therapies for Mental Health and Addiction.' The press release notes recent FDA guidance on psychedelic clinical investigations and inter-agency initiatives but does not announce any corporate transaction involving the company. No deal terms, stakeholder changes, or strategic alternatives are disclosed. This is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer providing a regulatory update, not a special-situation filing.
